summary: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on assets policy is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change any time as per the company policy.
key_rules: Provision of Assets i. Laptop Standard configuration of laptops shall be provided to all the employees on the basis of following mentioned details: ❖ For any Developer, QA Engineer or any similar IT Based profile Minimum 16 GB RAM (up to 32 GB) and 512 GB SSD Hard Disk with the processor of i5/i7 according to the profile. ❖ For any Sales, HR, Accountant, Designer or any similar non-IT Profile Minimum 16 GB RAM and 512 GB SSD Hard Disk with the processor of i5. ii. Provision of Laptop Based on Location
For employees working from Jaipur office the laptop can be provided on the date of joining itself
For employees joining from Gurgaon and Indore office the laptop will be dispatched after 7 working days from the date of joining
For employees joining from home the laptop will be dispatched after 21 working days from the date of joining iii. Spare Laptop for Work From Home
For employees joining from home, a spare laptop has to be arranged till the company laptop is not received by him/her.

If the spare laptop is not available, the employee needs to inform the asset manager while onboarding itself, and the laptop may be collected by the employee as stated in the clause below. 3 iv. Urgent Laptop Requirement

If in case the employee has an urgent need of the laptop and the work quality is getting affected due to unavailability of proper laptop, employee will have to collect their laptop from Jaipur office after a prior discussion and approval from asset manager and reporting manager. v. Screen, Mobile, Tablet, Testing Devices
Employee is eligible for the provision of a screen/monitor, Mobile, Tablet & Testing devices for the purpose of work if and only if the following conditions are satisfied:
There is client based or project based requirement of the assets. The Request of devices like mobile, tablet, testing devices, etc., should be approved by the direct reporting manager of the employee
The company will not provide external monitors to employees by default.
An external monitor will be issued only if it is absolutely required for client delivery, mandated by a specific project, or approved due to medical necessity.
All requests must include a written justification from the Reporting Manager and require final approval from Management and/or the Asset Manager.
Interns, hybrid employees, and remote employees are not eligible for an external monitor.

The screen or monitor cannot be provided or carried to the home/any other destination subject to prior approval from reporting manager & Assets manager. If in case any of the above conditions are not satisfied, the case shall be handled by the asset manager and the final decision will be taken on the basis of requirement/urgency and location of provision, subject to prior approval of management. 4 vi. General Conditions
Provision of asset is subject to availability
Any customized or upgraded asset provision apart from the standard configuration will be subject to the approval by management.
The final decision for provision of assets remains with the management

Lost or Theft of Assets The safety and security of assets provided by the company is the responsibility of an employee. In the event of lost or theft of an asset, following actions shall be taken by the employee on immediate basis:
The incident shall be reported to Asset Manager and Reporting Manager

A FIR should be filed by the employee and a copy of the FIR should be mailed to Asset Manager, keeping Accounts Manager and Reporting Manager in CC A committee shall be formed consisting of Asset Manager, Accounts Manager and Reporting Manager which would be responsible for investigating, analyzing and reporting the case of loss or theft.
The employee shall bear the cost of the loss due to lost or stolen laptop.
The cost would include the depreciated value of asset in the beginning of the current financial year and the value of data the asset holds (if any)
The above said committee would be deciding the cost which is to be borne by the employee.
Repayment installments can vary if the above said committee agrees on any other distribution. 5 i. Lost or Stolen and Found Asset
If an asset is lost/stolen and is found at a later stage by the employee, the employee shall inform the asset manager on priority basis.
After checking the condition of the asset, the asset manager would then take charge of the laptop.
The amount which has been charged for the asset which was lost or stolen shall be refunded back to the employee, if the asset is in working state.

If in case there are any damages which are not covered under the brand warranty, the repair amount shall be deducted from the refunded amount. Please Note: The Final decision in any case if lost or theft stays with the management.
Safety of an asset remains the responsibility of the employee.
If there is any physical damage to an asset, the incident shall immediately be reported to the Asset Manager on Keka Help Desk.
